LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.ManageDesc: View your plot, renew a rental, or enter with this caravan.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.Offer: Buy a permanent plot or prepay a rental. You can enter after payment.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.BunkerOptionTip: Start with an enclosed room under a removable constructed roof. The granite perimeter takes one tile on each side, leaving an 8 by 8 interior on a 10 by 10 plot. Larger bunkers also have roof support columns.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.BunkerUnavailabl: The bunker layout is unavailable because its map generator could not load.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.Recovery: Recovery only. Pack and remove your belongings.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.ViewPlotDesc: Switch to the plot map to see your buildings, goods, and any pawns there.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.RecoverOrphanDes: Enter this plot to pack and return its belongings. The contract could not be recovered.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.LeaveDesc: Leave settlement land. Choose who and what to take, then reform a stopped caravan near the host.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.RelinquishConfir: Relinquish this plot permanently? Any remaining pawns will be evacuated. Structures and goods left on the plot will be lost.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.BuyConfirm: Buy a permanent {0} × {0} plot for {1} silver? Your caravan will remain at the settlement until you choose to enter.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.RentConfirm: Pay {2} silver for {1} day(s) on a {0} × {0} plot? Rent is paid through {3}. You have {4} days of grace, until {5}, to renew or remove belongings. Living pawns and their inventories will be evacuated at reclamation. Structures and other goods left behind will be lost.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.SaleConfirm: Sell your {1} × {1} plot at {0} for {2} silver? Your caravan will receive the silver and you will give up ownership of the plot.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.SaleConfirmGener: Sell your {1} × {1} plot at {0} for {2} silver? Your caravan will receive the silver. All buildings, terrain improvements, and goods left on the plot go with the land and are permanently lost to you.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.SaleCompleted: Your caravan received {0} silver for the plot.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.SaleBlockedOccup: Remove all living pawns from the plot before selling it.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.SaleBlockedBusy: Wait for packing or transfers to finish before selling the plot.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.SaleBlockedDepen: Resolve the connected pocket map before selling this plot.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.SaleFailed: The settlement could not complete the sale. You still own the plot.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.Invalid: This settlement land request is no longer valid.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.Changed: The plot or its lease changed. Review the updated offer.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.PriceChanged: The land price changed. Review the updated offer and confirm again.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.PriceUnavailable: A silver price is unavailable for this offer.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.Unavailable: Settlement land is unavailable because a required game hook or definition could not load.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.HostIneligible: Settlement land is available at eligible humanlike surface settlements.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.MapLimit: There are too many maps loaded to acquire or generate a new plot. Existing maps remain accessible.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.StandardCaravan: Settlement land requires a standard surface caravan without a vehicle or shuttle.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.RecordError: This plot's saved record needs repair. Its existing property is protected from reclamation.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.EmptyRecovery: This plot has no map or belongings to recover.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.GenerationFailed: The plot map could not be generated. Your entitlement is still on record.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.PaymentFailed: The settlement could not complete this payment.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.ArrivalBlocked: There are too few safe cells for the whole caravan to enter.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.EntryFailed: The caravan could not enter the plot. Check the caravan and plot before trying again.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.RecoveryOrders: Construction and new zoning orders are suspended during recovery.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.KeepArrivalClear: Keep the paved caravan arrival area clear of blocking structures.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.NoDepartureTile: No passable surface tile is available for this caravan.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.NoOccupants: There are no living pawns on this plot.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.EmergencyConfirm: Evacuate the plot? Pawns will keep their gear and inventories. They will form or join a caravan if possible, or be queued for delivery to a player home.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.EvacuationFailed: Some pawns could not be moved safely. The plot is still available for recovery.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.DedicatedDialog: Use the settlement land dialog to manage this service.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.WarningBody: Rent for plot {0} at {1} is paid through {2}. Visit the settlement to renew.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.ExpiredBody: Rent for plot {0} at {1} expired. You can renew or remove belongings until {2}. Construction and new zoning are suspended.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.ReclaimedBody: Plot {0} at {1} has been reclaimed. Any living pawns were evacuated with their inventories. The remaining property included {2} haulable stacks and {3} buildings.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Land.HostLostBody: {1}, the host of plot {0}, is gone. Use the plot command with a caravan at the former settlement tile or its nearest passable recovery tile. Existing rental deadlines still apply.
